chars.YOUSSEF: YOUSSEF: a thin young Moroccan man of 24 with short black curly hair and a thin mustache, wearing a crisp white hotel staff shirt, a burgundy waistcoat with a small gold name pin and a black bow tie
chars.CLAIRE: CLAIRE: a European woman of 37 with wavy shoulder-length auburn hair, large round tortoiseshell glasses, an emerald green linen dress and gold hoop earrings
chars.MANAGER: MANAGER: a stern Moroccan hotel manager in his fifties with a short grey beard, wearing a dark navy suit and a gold name badge

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Lobby of a Moroccan hotel with zellige tiles and horseshoe arches. A group of European tourists with suitcases arrives; in front, CLAIRE stops and stares straight at YOUSSEF who freezes holding a tray, while the MANAGER behind the reception desk glares at YOUSSEF suspiciously. Tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot of CLAIRE standing at the hotel reception with her suitcase, smiling mysteriously over her glasses towards the camera, tour group blurred behind her, warm afternoon light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Across the hotel lobby, YOUSSEF and CLAIRE lock eyes for a long moment, both frozen, YOUSSEF wide-eyed and nervous, CLAIRE calm and curious, a fountain between them.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a hotel staff corridor the MANAGER points a stern finger at YOUSSEF and warns him angrily, YOUSSEF stands straight looking scared, other staff in uniforms in the background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF serves mint tea at a lobby table, looking down at the floor shyly, while CLAIRE sitting in an armchair keeps watching him over her glasses with a small smile.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: CLAIRE walks out of the hotel's carved wooden entrance door with her tour group and a Moroccan tour guide holding a small flag, she glances back over her shoulder, sunny street with palm trees.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Evening at six o'clock, YOUSSEF in casual clothes (black hoodie, jeans) with his work uniform folded on his arm, exits the hotel's back staff door into a narrow alley, golden sunset light, looking tired but free.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: On a busy Moroccan street at dusk with street lamps, CLAIRE (same green dress) suddenly stops in front of YOUSSEF (black hoodie, jeans) and smiles, asking him something, YOUSSEF surprised and nervous, old medina walls behind them.
